item.title: Gonzales City Council to vote on baseball field after striking out twice
item.description: GONZALES - America's favorite pastime is back on the City of Gonzales agenda on Monday after an agreement failed to pass at the last two council meetings.The agreement would allow the Ascension Parish Government to use the city's eight baseball and softball fields for its parish programming. item.title: Road work will close lanes in portion of Bluebonnet Boulevard
item.description: ST. GEORGE - A portion of Bluebonnet Boulevard will have partial road closures over the next month.&nbsp;The City of St. George said Monday that from Gail Drive to Jefferson Highway, Bluebonnet will be under construction from Feb. 12 to March 12.&nbsp;The project is under the Sales Tax Street and Road Rehabilitation Program and will be managed by the City-Parish of Baton Rouge.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: LSP: 21-year-old Mexican national arrested, booked for indecent behavior with a juvenile

item.title: One dead in shooting at Perkins Rowe parking garage
item.description: ST. GEORGE - A man was shot to death in a Perkins Rowe parking garage on Monday evening.&nbsp;Sources told WBRZ the shooting happened around 9:15 p.m. in the garage behind the Cinemark movie theatre.&nbsp;The man was pronounced dead at the scene.&nbsp;The East Baton Rouge Sheriff's Office says the shooting may have been self-inflicted, but the situation is under investigation.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Central residents react to proposed millages rolling forwards
item.description: CENTRAL - Residents in Central are asking for more communication from the school board after an effort to roll forward two millages, which would increase property taxes.&nbsp;Back in May, residents voted against a tax renewal that had been in place since 2009.&nbsp;"Communication is key to everything. item.title: Southern survives thrilling contest against Alabama State
item.description: BATON ROUGE - The Southern men's basketball team defeated Alabama St. in a nailbiter 69-68 to win their third straight game of the season. Fazi Oshodi hit a buzzer- beating three-pointer to clinch the Jags' first three-game winning streak of the season.Despite the end of game dramatics, Southern did not shoot well from beyond the arc.
